turns.assessment: The simultaneous bidirectional AMP_INPUT_LOS and OSC_LOS localize the failure to the physical fibre span immediately before the paired amp4 sites. Loss of both signal and OSC in both directions is the characteristic pattern of a cable cut affecting both fibres; unchanged pump currents argue strongly against amplifier pump failure. A very large span-loss increase is possible but less likely than a hard cut.

proposals.rationale: At the same instant, both directional span representations lost OSC and both downstream amp4 inputs lost all optical power. Fibre cuts normally sever both fibres in the cable and directly explain this symmetric hard-loss pattern.
An extreme common cable impairment could add enough loss to lose both payload and OSC, but simultaneous complete loss in both directions is more consistent with a cut.
